**[[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]]<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide">

{{Quote|General, the enemy fire is penetrating our shields!|Ponds, to Mace Windu|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
'''Ponds''',<!-- See [[Forum:CT:Ponds page name vote]] for page name discussion --> designated and formerly known as '''CC-6454''', was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Assigned to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Ponds earned his [[General/Legends|General's]] trust as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], a division of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and Ponds assisted Windu in [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invading]] the planet to secure its liberation. Windu and Ponds ultimately joined forces with General [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and his [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] to retake Ryloth from the Confederacy, capturing the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] and taking Tambor as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of the Republic.

In addition to campaigns at [[Simocadia]], [[Juma 9]], and [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]], Ponds participated in the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] and assisted Windu in capturing a [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|rampant Zillo Beast]] that had been awoken from the detonation of an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]]. He later joined Windu on a respite from the war aboard the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], at the time of the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts on Windu. After bringing down the ''Endurance'' on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], Fett and his crew of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]&mdash;[[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], and [[Castas/Legends|Castas]]&mdash;took Ponds, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]], and a [[Unidentified clone navigation officer (Endurance)/Legends|clone naval officer]] hostage to bait Windu into a confrontation. As part of their hostage demands, Sing executed Ponds and later ejected his body from their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].

==Biography==
===Debut on Geonosis===
{{Quote|Sir. I have five special commando units awaiting your orders, sir.|Ponds, reporting to Mace Windu on Geonosis|<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ponds_AotC.png|thumb|left|225px|Ponds during the Battle of Geonosis.]]
CC-6454, who took on the name Ponds, was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Born]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], he was one of the many clones of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], grown by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ponds was part of<ref name="Encyclopedia: Ponds" /> the 200,000 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] whom [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] gathered from Kamino for a strike force bound for [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where the Republic was launching a campaign to rescue several captives&mdash;[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]&mdash;who had been marked for [[Death/Legends|execution]] by the newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the resulting [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Ponds reported to Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and gathered five [[Commando/Legends|commando]] units for Windu's use. The battle was ultimately won for the Republic,<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> and Ponds continued to serve under Windu as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Ponds" />

===Battle of Ryloth===
{{Quote|Droids have begun a firebombing campaign. Several villages in our sector have been destroyed, sir.|Ponds, to Mace Windu|audio=FireBombingCampaign-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ponds_and_Windu.png|thumb|right|250px|Ponds and Windu brace themselves during enemy fire over Ryloth.]]
As the war went on during the first year, the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] and [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member, [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and enslaved its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants. After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Anakin Skywalker and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] eliminated the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the planet,<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> Ponds accompanied General Windu aboard an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]. Windu's invasion force, consisting of three Acclamator transports, prepared to land in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], but they were attacked by Confederate [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon|proton cannons]] stationed below in the city. Ponds informed Mace Windu that the cannons had penetrated the transports' [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], and as he spoke, one of the transports was destroyed.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> Windu instructed [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] Obi-Wan Kenobi to destroy the cannons and allow their transports to land in Nabat. Kenobi was able to eliminate the cannons, and the two remaining transports were able to land. The ground forces were deployed, and soon headed to Ryloth's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] to retake it and free the planet.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

En route to Lessu, Ponds accompanied Windu and led the GAR unit [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], as well as, several [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]]. Along a cliff-side path, the forces were attacked by several Confederate [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], which sought to trap the Republic forces on the cliff, and incapacitated the front walkers before targeting those at the rear. Windu and Ponds led an attack with Lightning Squadron and several [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT walkers]] on the tanks.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Although the tanks were defeated, the ambush had taken the lives of thirty-two of their men, along with three AT-TE command crews. Windu and Ponds needed reinforcements to be able to succeed.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide" />

Windu entered a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] conference with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]; Jedi Grand Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]; Ryloth's Twi'lek senator, [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]]; and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. Windu discovered that there were no reinforcements available, but decided to enlist the help of Twi'lek [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and his [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]]&mdash;a resistance movement that had been fighting the Confederacy since its invasion&mdash;to help the Republic defeat the Confederacy. Windu went with [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] [[Razor/Legends|Razor]] and [[Stak/Legends|Stak]] to meet the rebels,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide" /> while Ponds continued to Lessu with the remainder of his forces.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

[[File:Ponds_watches_Ryloth_village_destruction.png|thumb|left|250px|Ponds witnesses the destruction of a Twi'lek village.]]
After coming across a Twi'lek village, Ponds ordered the troopers to spare some rations for the Twi'lek women and children that were still there. Suddenly, several Confederate [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] appeared and swooped down on the village, dropping [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] and destroying the village in a matter of seconds. A shocked Ponds reported this to Windu, and the increasing losses of lives convinced Syndulla to reopen negotiations with his political rival, Senator Taa. Syndulla resolved his issues with Taa, and decided to join Windu and his forces. The group devised a plan to enter Lessu; however, the only solution would be to activate the city's [[Plasma bridge/Legends|plasma bridge]], as it was the only access to Lessu, and the bridge's controls were inside the city itself. To infiltrate the city, Windu decided to sneak onto one of two Confederate [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] carrying stolen treasure for Emir Tambor. However, they would only have a short amount of time before being discovered, and Ponds and Syndulla needed to give Windu as much time as possible to get across.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

Accompanied by Razor and Stak, Windu sneaked onto one of the MTTs. When their presence was revealed, the Jedi and the two clones made a run for the other side of the plasma bridge while Ponds and Syndulla commenced the attack. Windu and the clones were able to get across, and Syndulla led the charge towards the bridge. Razor and Stak managed to activate the bridge, and, after the Republic forces crossed and entered the city, Windu cornered Tambor. Four ''Hyena'' bombers prepared to destroy the city under orders from Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], but the timely intervention of General Skywalker and Commander Tano in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|fighters]] thwarted the attempt. After the battle had ended, Ponds attended a parade on Ryloth with Syndulla, Taa, and Windu.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

===Battle of Behpour===
Immediately following Ryloth, a Separatist [[Gravitic polarization beam|superweapon]] was discovered on [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] by [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], created by [[Kul Teska]], the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] agent who led the attack on Juma-9. Ponds was among the Republic task force dispatched to destroy the weapon before it could collapse the [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo sun]]. Once Generals Kenobi and Skywalker knocked out the facility's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]], the clones entered the facility, quickly securing the entrance. Ponds later assisted Cody and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] in securing a landing platform for Skywalker's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].<ref name="Republic Heroes" />

===Battle of Juma-9===
A short while after Ryloth, the Station [[Juma 9]] fell under attack. Along with Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], Mace Windu and Commander Ponds sought to recapture the station. They found Clone Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and, while the Jedi entered the station, the clones scouted on the station's surface where they encountered some droids. Eventually they destroyed all the droids and found two lightsabers in space. They met up with the two owners of the lightsabers&mdash;Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who had been separated from their weapons by a ray shield, thus forcing the Jedi to go around the ray shield. Eventually they made it and received their sabers. The Battle of [[Juma 9]] was won.<ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

===Battle of Malastare===
<!--It's not confirmed whether or not Trapper or Hawkeye was killed. Please do not speculate.-->
[[File:Hello_beastie.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ponds firing at the newly awakened Zillo Beast]]
Ponds helped Mace Windu look for survivors in the Zillo Beast's hole. Mace Windu ordered him, [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]] and [[Hawkeye/Legends|Hawkeye]] to look around. Soon the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] found them and chased them. However; Mace, Ponds, and another trooper were able to escape aboard a gunship.<ref name="TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

===Tour on the ''Endurance''===
{{Quote|I'm staying with the Admiral. You'd better evacuate.|Ponds orders a clone trooper to evacuate from the ''Endurance''|<ref name="DT">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>}}
On board the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer ''Endurance'', Ponds told Mace and Skywalker to go to the bridge before the two Jedi had the chance to give a group of clone cadets a tour of the ship. However, a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had infiltrated a contingent of the clone youth brigade who where touring the ship, with the intention of avenging his [[Jango Fett/Legends|father's]] death at the hands of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Fett managed to slip away from the rest of the clone youth brigade and proceeded to destroy the ship's main reactor. Ponds and several other clones were sent to see who or what had destroyed the reactor. Later, Ponds said he would stay on the ''Endurance'' with Admiral [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] and go down with the ship while the rest of clones would evacuate.<ref name="DT" />

===Capture and death===
{{Quote|That was Ponds.|Anakin Skywalker, after witnessing the transmission from ''Slave I''|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />}}
[[File:Ponds_ejected.png|thumb|left|250px|Ponds' corpse is ejected into space.]]
After the crash, Ponds was kidnapped along with Admiral Kilian and another clone officer by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Castas/Legends|Castas]], and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]].<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref> At first, the bounty hunters intended to ransom the three of them off to the Separatists. When their booby trap failed, Sing decided to use her hostages as bait to lure Mace Windu into the open so that Boba could kill the Jedi who murdered his father. They decided to send a message trying to convince the Jedi to come, and they ordered Boba to kill Ponds to show they meant business. When Boba hesitated to do it, Aurra got tired of waiting and killed Ponds herself when he refused. As the Jedi watched in horror, the bounty hunters then cut off the transmission. Later, the bounty hunters dumped Ponds' body out into space.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CommanderPondsDetail-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|Ponds in full armor]]
{{Quote|The enemy's already pulled out, sir. Friendlies are all that's left, mostly women and children.''"<br />"''See if we can spare some rations. They'll be hungry.|A clone trooper and Ponds|audio=SpareSomeRations-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
Ponds was obedient and followed orders. He was assertive and did not hesitate when giving orders himself, as shown when he immediately ordered Lightning Squadron to the front of the Republic line of walkers during the cliffside ambush. Ponds was also compassionate: when he learned that there were only Twi'lek women and children in a nearby village, he took pity on them and ordered his men to spare rations, and was shocked and angry when the Confederacy bombed the village.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

He held friendships with fellow officers [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and Commander Cody, respectively. He comforted the latter when he expressed his concern for Generals Plo Koon and Obi-Wan Kenobi on the Juma 9 station mission. He additionally complemented Rex's shooting skills on Behpour.

After being captured by Aurra Sing, Ponds refused to answer her when she asked for his name, doing it only after she forcefully demanded it. Just before Aurra killed Ponds, he calmly closed his eyes and accepted his death.

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Missile rounds, General: A clone's best friend.|Ponds, to Mace Windu|<ref name="The Droid Deception">{{TCWComicCite|6.4|The Droid Deception}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ponds-SWE.png|thumb|left|220px|Ponds was equipped with Phase I clone trooper armor and dual DC-17 blaster pistols.]]
Ponds' armor featured dark-red markings upon his helmet, arms, shoulder plates, towards the back of his torso, and from his knee pads down to the mid-calf. Ponds also wore a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] that bore two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]], which he used on Malastare.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> On the back of Ponds' helmet, "Some guys have all the luck" was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide" /> He also made use of a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbine on [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|What's your name? Name!''"<br />"''CT-411.''"<br />"''Pathetic. Boba, do it.|Aurra Sing and Ponds, the latter reciting an erroneous designation|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />}}
Ponds, like all the other clone troopers in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. After being first mentioned, albeit briefly, in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]), he made his first appearance in the series' [[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episodes "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]" and "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]."

In the [[2010]] episode "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," when Aurra Sing asks Ponds for his name, he gives the number "CT-411," which contradicts the "CC-6454" designation given in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']] reference book and repeated in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], both released in 2009. This was later revised in the [[2010]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', which gave him the new designation "CC-0411" after the conflicting number from "Lethal Trackdown." However, when Ponds received an entry in the [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|StarWars.com Encyclopedia]] in [[2012]], his designation was listed as the previously stated "CC-6454." This article assumes that the latter is correct, as precedence is given to the Encyclopedia as the most recent published source.

''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'' mentioned that Ponds was assigned to Mace Windu at the Battle of Geonosis, which was depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Although ''Republic Heroes'' stated that he had been assigned to Windu after Geonosis, Ponds's 2012 Encyclopedia entry confirmed his role during the battle, going so far as to [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] a clone commander in the film as Ponds.

Ponds appeared in the comic ''[[The Clone Wars: The Colossus of Destiny]]'', but wore armor that had blue stripes down his arms, and two blue eyes on his helmet, over his visor.
